title: Workflow Read Response
description: 200 response body for GET /api/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}, per vertical-slice-01.md Section 5. Same public identifiers as the submit response, plus revision and permitted timestamps.

correlation_id.description: The workflow's original durable correlation_id (unchanged by replay, see ADR-0012).

revision.description: Monotonically increasing workflow snapshot revision, per vertical-slice-01.md Section 9.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of workflow acceptance.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the current revision.

result.description: Present only when state is COMPLETED. Shape is capability-scoped (ADR-0015): e.g. {"word_count": integer} for text.word-count, {"summary": string} for text.summarize. The caller already knows which capability it submitted.

failure.description: Present only when state is FAILED.
